summary: Full backend + frontend testing for Bhavy Agarwal portfolio. All 6 backend pytest cases pass (health, contact CRUD with persistence, 3 validation cases returning 422, resume PDF served with 200). Frontend loaded successfully via public URL: hero (wordmark 'BHAVY AGARWAL', OPEN TO WORK status badge, live NOIDA IN time, photo placeholder, Download Resume + Email Me CTAs) all present with correct data-testids. Floating pill navbar renders all 6 links; clicking nav-projects smooth-scrolls Projects section into view. Contact form empty-submit shows 'Please fill in all fields.' toast (error path). Valid submit posts to /api/contact and shows 'Message sent! Bhavy will get back to you soon.' toast and clears all 3 inputs. Resume link href is /Bhavy_Agarwal_Resume.pdf and returns 200. Project cards 01/02/03 render and the entire card anchor points to https://github.com/bhavyagarwal12 (data.js verified).

issues: Console warning: 'Please ensure that the container has a non-static position, like relative/fixed/absolute to ensure scroll offset is calculated correctly.' — cosmetic; scrolling still works.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py: `logger` is defined AFTER it is referenced in create_contact's except handlers (module-load order). Works at runtime because it's inside a function, but move logger initialization above route definitions for clarity.
server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('shutdown'); prefer FastAPI lifespan handler.

Email HTML in _send_owner_email interpolates user-provided name/message directly into HTML without escaping — potential HTML injection in the received email (low-risk since only owner receives it, but consider html.escape()).
seed_data_creation: Created test contact_messages doc with TEST_ prefix (id auto-generated by backend).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_portfolio_api.py — pytest passes all 6. Use BASE_URL from REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Frontend uses data-testids consistently; contact form and nav smooth-scroll verified working via public preview URL.
